[quote=cordone;58019573][b]Question of the Day #8:[/b]

[i]What administrative divisions does your nation divide itself up into? (Counties, Province, Govenorates, etc[/i][/quote]
Qhapac Pitipi: A Qhapac Pitipi, translating it becomes "King City" is a city that is directly controlled by the monarch to administer, however he can gives the city to a kuraq administer it as well, the Qhapac Pitipi currently are: Chanchán, Chimbote and Pacatnamu.
Sanga: An equivalent of a province, but it translation means "part", the Chimor territory is divided into three Sangas, Chansanga(Chan= center, central part) which capital is Chanchán, Farcsanga, which means Eastern part, capital being Farfán, and Irmasanga, the Part of the Irma capital being Ishma, at the west.
Every Sanga has a leader called "Apu" choosen by the Chimor Qhapac
Chápan: A Chápan is an adiministrative division that composes a Sanga, each Sanga has a total of 5-10 Chápans, it adiministrator is elected locally, called a "Wamán"
Poya: the lowest administrative division in Chimor Kingdom, a Poya is composed of 5-10 villages, making the size equivalent of a town, each Chápan has at least 12 Poyas, ruled by a Tocho, who is also responsible for collecting taxes from his poya and give to the Wamán or Apu.
